title: Ajax Systems
description: Ajax Systems alarm & automation — Hub, detectors, sirens, relays, sockets. Connect via Ajax REST API, gRPC cloud, or local SIA listener.

mode.title: Connection mode
mode.description: api = official Ajax REST API (arm/disarm + polling); grpc = mobile cloud gateway (app protocol); sia = local SIA DC-09 listener (events only).

email.title: Ajax account email
email.description: Email of the Ajax account (api/grpc modes).

appLabel.title: Application label
appLabel.description: App label for gRPC (e.g. 'Ajax', or a co-branded app like 'ADT').

totp.title: 2FA TOTP code
totp.description: One-time TOTP code if two-factor authentication is enabled.

apiKey.title: API key (X-Api-Key)
apiKey.description: Ajax API key issued to your application/PRO account. Required by the official Ajax REST API in api mode.

apiToken.title: API token
apiToken.description: User API or PRO API token (alternative to email/password in api mode).

apiUserId.title: API user id
apiUserId.description: Numeric Ajax user id used with an API token. Leave empty when using email + password.

siaPort.title: SIA listener port
siaPort.description: TCP port the hub sends SIA DC-09 events to.

armPin.title: Arm/disarm PIN
armPin.description: User code/PIN required for arming if configured on the hub.

allowForceArm.title: Allow force arm
allowForceArm.description: Allow arming while detectors are open (ignore problems). Advanced.

exposeDemoDevices.title: Expose demo devices
exposeDemoDevices.description: Expose a representative set of demo devices (no account needed). For testing only.

whiteList.title: White List
whiteList.description: Only the devices in the list will be exposed. If empty, all devices are exposed.

blackList.title: Black List
blackList.description: Devices in the list will not be exposed.

debug.title: Enable Debug
debug.description: Enable debug logging for the plugin.
